cohort: 495 Bengali Hindu newborns born at full gestational age from singleton pregnancies in Kolkata, West Bengal, India, between August 2016 and March 2017.
finding: Both birth length and head circumference were significantly correlated with birth weight, and can be used to predict low birth weight, with birth length being the slightly better predictor.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 2.72 kg +/- 0.44 kg, and 27.10% of newborns were low birth weight.
